_pricing_notes._legacy_retained: gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-sol (judge pins until the 2026-10-03 amendment), gpt-5.4, gpt-5.5, gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.1-codex-max, claude-opus-4-7, claude-opus-4-6, claude-sonnet-4-6, gemini-3.1-pro-preview are intentionally RETAINED after the gpt-5.6 / Claude-5 repin and the E2-1 agy repin so archived attempt rows still price correctly on /pp:replay. computeCost() looks up by literal model id and silently returns 0 on a miss — never delete a key that appears in a historical attempt row.
